source_evidence: For U.S. citizens born between January 1, 2025, and December 31, 2028, the federal government will make a one-time $1,000 contribution—called the pilot program payment—into each child’s Trump Account.
answer: The Trump Account pilot program payment is a one-time $1,000 contribution from the federal government for each U.S. citizen born between January 1, 2025, and December 31, 2028. It is a single contribution to the child’s Trump Account, not a recurring payment.
